string-array.name: wall_street_quotes
string-array.item: \"In the market, patience is a weapon.\" — Warren Buffett
\"Be fearful when others are greedy, and greedy when others are fearful.\" — Warren Buffett
\"Price is what you pay. Value is what you get.\" — Warren Buffett
\"If you aren\'t willing to own a stock for ten years, don\'t even think about owning it for ten minutes.\" — Warren Buffett
\"Diversification is protection against ignorance.\" — Warren Buffett
\"Compound interest is the eighth wonder of the world.\" — Albert Einstein
\"The stock market is a device for transferring money from the impatient to the patient.\" — Warren Buffett
\"Risk comes from not knowing what you\'re doing.\" — Warren Buffett
\"Rule No. 1: Never lose money.\" — Warren Buffett
\"The most important investment you can make is in yourself.\" — Warren Buffett
\"No pain, no gain.\" — Ray Dalio
\"Embrace reality and deal with it.\" — Ray Dalio
\"The biggest mistake is failing to learn from your mistakes.\" — Ray Dalio
\"Diversification is a free lunch.\" — Ray Dalio
\"Don\'t fear the truth. Understand it.\" — Ray Dalio
\"The market can remain irrational longer than you can remain solvent.\" — John Maynard Keynes
\"The key to investing is not knowing more than others, but being more disciplined.\" — Seth Klarman
\"Time is the friend of the wonderful business, the enemy of the mediocre.\" — Warren Buffett
\"Investing is a loser\'s game, not a winner\'s game. Minimize mistakes.\" — Charles Ellis
\"All intelligent investing is value investing.\" — Charlie Munger
\"Invert, always invert.\" — Charlie Munger
\"Keep it simple and stick to the fundamentals.\" — Charlie Munger
\"Knowing the edge of your competence is the beginning of wisdom.\" — Charlie Munger
\"The time of maximum pessimism is the best time to buy.\" — John Templeton
\"Bull markets are born on pessimism, grow on skepticism, mature on optimism, and die on euphoria.\" — John Templeton
\"Past performance does not guarantee future results.\" — Wall Street Proverb
\"Don\'t put all your eggs in one basket.\" — Wall Street Proverb
\"Buying is a skill; selling is an art.\" — Wall Street Proverb
\"The four most dangerous words in investing are: \'this time it\'s different.\'\" — John Templeton
\"You can\'t predict. You can prepare.\" — Howard Marks
\"To be a superior investor, you must think differently from the crowd.\" — Howard Marks
\"Risk means more things can happen than will happen.\" — Elroy Dimson
\"In the short run, the market is a voting machine; in the long run, a weighing machine.\" — Benjamin Graham
\"Margin of safety is the cornerstone of investing.\" — Benjamin Graham
\"The investor\'s chief problem — and even his worst enemy — is likely to be himself.\" — Benjamin Graham
\"Short-term, stocks are a voting machine; long-term, a weighing machine.\" — Benjamin Graham
\"A good investment is buying a great company at a fair price.\" — Philip Fisher
\"If you bought a stock you have to sell, you shouldn\'t have bought it in the first place.\" — Philip Fisher
\"Don\'t chase returns. Stick to your principles.\" — John Bogle
\"Don\'t look for the needle in the haystack. Just buy the haystack.\" — John Bogle
\"Cutting costs is the surest way to boost returns.\" — John Bogle
\"Don\'t try to beat the market. Own it.\" — John Bogle
\"The trend is your friend — until the end when it bends.\" — Ed Seykota
\"Cut your losses short, let your profits run.\" — Jesse Livermore
\"The big money is made by sitting, not trading.\" — Jesse Livermore
\"There is nothing new on Wall Street. The history of speculation repeats itself.\" — Jesse Livermore
\"Buy when there\'s blood in the streets.\" — Baron Rothschild
\"Be cautious when markets are greedy; be patient when they are fearful.\" — Peter Lynch
\"Invest in what you know.\" — Peter Lynch
\"A market decline is a sale — a chance to buy great stocks cheaply.\" — Peter Lynch
\"Markets are always wrong. What matters is whether you can exploit their errors.\" — George Soros
\"Invest first, investigate later.\" — George Soros
\"Don\'t blame the windmill when the wind doesn\'t blow.\" — Nassim Taleb
\"Rare events shape history.\" — Nassim Taleb
\"Buy stocks, take sleeping pills, and when you wake up years later, you\'ll be rich.\" — André Kostolany
\"For the patient investor, the stock market is an ATM.\" — André Kostolany

\"October: This is one of the peculiarly dangerous months to speculate in stocks. The others are July, January, September, April, November, May, March, June, December, August, and February.\" — Mark Twain
\"What will the market do? It will fluctuate.\" — J.P. Morgan
\"Investing should be more like watching paint dry or grass grow. If you want excitement, take $800 and go to Las Vegas.\" — Paul Samuelson
\"The big money is made not by trading, but by waiting.\" — Stanley Druckenmiller
\"The market itself is the best teacher — learn to read its moves.\" — William O\'Neil
\"Wealth is built by how you behave when no one is watching.\" — Morgan Housel
\"Savings equals income minus ego.\" — Morgan Housel
